title: FastAPI Services
description: Serving pipeline results over HTTP with FastAPI: routes, validation and tests, read-only endpoints for loaded results, calling the course's Spring Boot API with a configured service URL, token and timeouts, and a cumulative Python review.
sourceCoverageNotes: Covers S18 rows 0-2 and S19 row 0; Fast FT11 rows 1-2 map here.
FT11 row 1 'FastAPI routes that serve pipeline results' combines S18 rows 0 and 1 and is split across fastapi-routes and serving-pipeline-results-as-an-api (confirmed matrix v3).
S19 row 1 and FT11 row 4 'Python module check' map to the course-level blueprint python/assessments/python-module-check, never to a learner topic.
python-review (S19 row 0, kind review) is Standard-only retrieval; Fast learners have no review row.
No module coding lab: the confirmed expected-artifact scope gives S18 Concept-day topics no lab overlay; TestClient and httpx mock-transport practice runs in the page simulators.
